items.title: Karolina Strassmayer interviewed by Monk Rowe, May 25, 2023
items.q: I found out what I heard was Julian “Cannonball” Adderley on the alto saxophone. And then basically I sold my Moped and bought a saxophone for it

ctx.x: He’s still in there, he’s in my heart and just, when I first heard him I had no idea what jazz was. I had no idea which instruments were playing. It was really — I grew up in a very small village in the Austrian Alps and I had to commute to go to high school. And a small group of us kids we had to be at the train station at 5:30 every morning to make it

to our school which was about an hour away. And one morning my friend came with a bag of cassette tapes. I mean we’re talking about the 80s right, so we’re still dealing with cassette tapes. And her older sister had — she wanted to get rid of some of those tapes and just dumped them on her little sister who was my friend and then she came to the train station in the morning with this bag and she said, “Oh my sister gave me these tapes and I checked it out but it’s horrible, I don’t know what it is but I don’t…
Yeah. Were your parents curious about this bolt of lightening and were they supportive of your chosen path?
